limits: Twelve paired warmed samples per path/fixture and four batches, not population confidence
First four fixtures reset to identical isolated entry states; edge fixture evolves each owner independently without resets
Reset command tracking is outside the selected integration+response wall region; setup/cold observations retained
Plain/traced runs retain clock/NVTX instrumentation; tracer deltas include variance
CUDA synchronization waits overlap GPU work; do not add them to kernel durations
CUPTI register/local-memory metadata is not dynamic spill traffic or allocator footprint
